transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because after I have these eating episodes, I just feel really gross and disappointed in myself. Like I should be able to control it better. And then afterward I end up writing really awful things about myself in my journal.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after these eating episodes?
I don’t really have anything clear to say about that. I haven’t noticed that being part of what happens for me.
Do you exercise more than you feel is typical for someone of your age and fitness level after these eating episodes?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I do anything like a lot of extra exercise afterward, at least not that I’ve noticed.
Can you describe what happens during these eating episodes that makes you feel gross and disappointed in yourself?

When it starts, it’s like I stop really choosing. I’ll have one thing, and then I’m already reaching for the next thing almost automatically. Even if I’m thinking, Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish, I just… don’t stop. Usually I keep going until the food is gone or I feel too uncomfortable. Then I feel gross and really disappointed in myself.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over time?
I’m not really sure. I mean, my weight goes up and down a little, but I haven’t noticed some big change over time.
How often do these eating episodes happen?

For the past few months, it’s usually at least once a week. Most often it’s a night after work where I buy too much food and end up eating it all in one stretch. I can’t really think of a recent month where it stopped for more than maybe a week or so.
Do you ever use laxatives or diuretics after these eating episodes?
No, I don’t use anything like that after. I just feel bad and kind of sit with it, but I don’t take laxatives or water pills.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
I don’t know if I’d say I’m afraid of it. I don’t like the idea of gaining weight, but it’s not something I’m constantly worried about.
How often do you write those awful things about yourself in your journal after these eating episodes?

Pretty much after most of them. Not every single time, but a lot of the time I feel so gross and disappointed in myself that I end up writing things like I should have more control. It’s usually right after, when I’m feeling really bad about it.
Do you write awful things about yourself in your journal at any other times besides after these eating episodes?
Not really. It’s mostly after the eating episodes. That’s when I feel really gross and disappointed in myself, like I should’ve had more control, and I end up writing those awful things.
Do you ever write awful things about yourself in your journal when you're not feeling gross or disappointed about an eating episode?

No, not really. It’s usually tied to after I’ve had one of those eating episodes and I’m feeling gross or disappointed in myself. That’s when I end up writing those awful things, like I should’ve had more control.
Do you ever feel the need to punish yourself or make up for what you've eaten during these episodes in any way?
I don’t think so... I mean, I feel really bad afterward, but I don’t really do anything specific to punish myself or make up for it. It’s more just feeling guilty and upset.
Have you ever made yourself vomit after eating?
No, I haven’t made myself throw up after eating.
Are your eating episodes followed by feelings of fear that you will gain weight from what you've eaten?

I don’t know that it’s fear exactly. I might worry a little, like “I shouldn’t have eaten that much,” but I don’t usually sit there scared that I’m going to gain weight from it. It’s more just feeling bad about what happened.
Do you worry that you will gain weight after these eating episodes?
Not really in a strong way. I might think, like, “that was too much,” but I don’t sit there worrying a lot that I’m going to gain weight. It’s more just feeling bad about it.
When you write awful things about yourself in your journal after these eating episodes, is it usually about your weight or how you look?
I’m not really sure it’s about weight or how I look specifically. I think it’s more just me being really harsh on myself, like feeling upset that I did it again.
Is what you write about yourself in your journal after eating episodes ever related to your body shape or weight?
I haven’t really noticed it being about my body shape or weight. It’s more like I’m mad at myself or disappointed that it happened again.
When you write awful things about yourself, is it ever because you feel you've let yourself down by eating too much and that affects how you think about your body?

Yeah, I think it’s more that I feel like I let myself down. Like I should’ve had more control, and then afterward I feel gross and really disappointed in myself. That’s when I end up writing awful things in my journal. It’s not so much focused on my body exactly, just feeling bad about what I did.
Do you think the awful things you write about yourself are because you're worried about gaining weight from those eating episodes?

I don’t know that it’s specifically about gaining weight. I mean, maybe that’s in the back of my mind sometimes, but what I notice more is just feeling like I messed up and being really hard on myself afterward.
Is your self-criticism after eating episodes ever because you fear gaining weight from what you ate?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed it being clearly about fear of gaining weight. It’s more just that I feel upset with myself for eating that much, and then I get really critical.
